Rhizoctonia shows stem lesion on a more mature plant. Phytophthora shows wilted mature plant. Neither matches the test image's very young seedling in soil. Let me check 5 more classes to fulfill the 8-class requirement.

- **Phytophthora**: Wilted mature plant with dead leaves — different presentation
- **Fusarium**: Mature plant with curled stem — no match
- **Sudden_death_syndrome**: Field-level view of mature crop — no match
- **Brown_Stem_Rot**: Split stem showing internal browning — no match
- **Charcoal_Rot**: Field of yellowing/dying mature plants — no match
